title: Victorian Livestock Exchange Limited - acquisition of Sale and Korumburra Saleyard businesses and Yarram saleyard property in the Gippsland region
targets:
Sale Livestock Exchange
Korumburra South Gippsland Regional Saleyard
Yarram Saleyard Property

timeline.event: ACCC received initial submission from VLE
ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of further information from VLE to constitute a full submission
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
Full submission received from VLE. ACCC commenced review under Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC released a Statement of Issues
Closing date for submissions from interested parties on the Statement of Issues
ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of a response to the ACCC's Statement of Issues from VLE expected on 31 July 2006.
Decision date postponed to allow for VLE's response to ACCC's Statement of Issues
ACCC received response to the Statement of Issues from VLE
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition
